name: drawer
description: A sliding panel that emerges from an edge of the screen or centers responsively as an overlay.

accessibility.label: aria-labelledby points to title.
accessibility.description: aria-describedby points to description when present.
accessibility.focus: Trap focus inside while open and return focus to trigger on close.

constraints: Use Right for desktop side panels.
Use Responsive when one component must work across breakpoints.
Footer order is primary confirm above/before secondary dismiss.
Do not put navigation inside a drawer.
Only one drawer should be open at a time.

useCases: User taps a 'Filter' button on a mobile search page — a bottom sheet slides up with filter controls
A confirmation sheet asks 'Are you sure you want to delete this?' before a destructive action on mobile
A quick-settings tray opens from the bottom of a dashboard on a phone
A right-side inspector panel slides in on a desktop canvas app when an object is selected
A component that must work on both mobile and desktop uses the Responsive direction to show bottom on phone, floating panel on desktop
An action menu with 2–4 primary choices slides up from the bottom of a mobile list view

Bottom.whenToUse: Mobile-first flows; short forms, filters, or action confirmations anchored to the bottom edge

Right.whenToUse: Desktop side panels where the user continues to reference the main content
examples: Settings panel on a wide layout

Responsive.whenToUse: Single component that must serve both mobile and desktop without separate implementations
examples: Shared filter component used across breakpoints

comparedTo.situation: Bottom-anchored panel on mobile with swipe-to-dismiss
Side panel on desktop that slides in from left or right
Centered blocking modal that requires a decision before continuing

notes: Examples assume shadcn/Vaul Drawer primitives plus an Agentic DrawerPanel wrapper.

darkMode.notes: Container fill uses color/surface/default (Dark: zinc/900) — matches shadcn --card. Previously surface/overlay (zinc/800); changed to align with shadcn card hierarchy.
